latestVersion.changelog:
knowledge-system 1.0.0 – Build full Markdown-based AI Agent knowledge management

- Initial release with comprehensive SKILL.md documentation.
- Teaches building an AI Agent knowledge system using Markdown files only, no external databases/services.
- Defines modular file structure: SOUL, USER, AGENTS, TOOLS, MEMORY, daily memory, .learnings, and HEARTBEAT.
- Supports multiple Agents, memory collaboration, context compression, and regular self-improvement workflows.
- Provides step-by-step setup, sample file templates, workflow standards, and promotion/demotion rules for learnings.
